name: MTDC Resort Ganpatipule
location: Ganpatipule Beach, opposite Swayambhu Ganpati Temple
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's flagship beach resort directly opposite the Swayambhu Ganpati temple — 100+ rooms in Konkani-style cottages plus tented Konkan tents, the only true beach-walkout property in Ganpatipule. Books out for Ganesh Chaturthi 6 months ahead.

name: Atithi Parinay Konkan Homestay
why_special: Award-winning Konkani homestay run by the Atithi Parinay family — traditional Konkan farmhouse with surangya floor and laterite walls, signature alu-vadi/sol-kadhi Maharashtrian thali. The benchmark Konkan-coast homestay; on the Maharashtra Tourism registered list.

name: Abhishek Beach Resort & Spa
why_special: Beach-front resort 500 m from the Swayambhu Ganpati temple — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant with Konkani thali, the private-resort alternative to MTDC when their cottages are full.
